newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT, according to analysts.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.200 to off 0.100 cent. Cash markets still firm but talk of topping in live. Also, evening up seen ahead of Cattle-on-Feed report.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Index up and corn seen little up but tight feeder numbers ahead supportive.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.200 to 1.000 cent. Carryover from limit up and strong cash but concern market may be near top.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.250 to 1.000 cent. Limit up Thursday and cash firm but evening up seen ahead of storage report.
